parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data catalog.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   If **NextToken** is empty, there is no next page.
*   If a value of **NextToken** is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-data-lake-partition-name --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 3000 --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-name table_name --next-token f056501ada12c1cc --max-results 20 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise ListDataLakePartitionName --region cn-hangzhou --TableName table_name --NextToken f056501ada12c1cc --MaxResults 20 --WorkspaceId 120000 --CatalogName hive --DbName default --Tid 3000 --DataRegion 'cn-hangzhou'
